verdict.rationale: Box AI API is well documented with dedicated first-party docs for asking questions, extracting metadata, and summarizing files (box-docs-9, box-docs-12, box-docs-26, box-docs-33), plus a visual agent configurator and model selection (box-docs-42, box-docs-18), indicating a shipped, documented surface rather than just an announcement. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation of Box AI's actual output quality and reliability, and clearer documentation of usage limits/pricing tiers for the AI features.
